notes: Written 2026-09-02 by the netlist lane. The authoritative netlist is electronics/netlist.py (cecad.netlist.Design, 118 findings); this spec exists to record what bin/elec can and cannot do for a host without a pin roster.

2026-09-02 (lane C): THE COMPONENT ROSTER IS NOT IN THIS FILE, and that is deliberate. Every electronic component's envelope, mass, quantity, role and open items live in electronics/components.json, and the generated datasheet is ELECTRONICS-DATASHEET.html (tools/gen_electronics_datasheet.py, which also reads ce-parts/<slug>/ live). They are not here because ce-elec's loader refuses any key outside its fixed roster — ce-elec/elec/levels.py:39 SPEC_KEYS and :105-113, 'A key silently ignored is a requirement silently dropped' — so a `components` key here would break `bin/elec levels` for this design rather than extend it. Two files, both loadable, neither duplicating the other.
